# Frey Clinic of Chiropractic

> Chiropractic care, acupuncture, massage therapy, and wellness services in Napoleon, Ohio. Family-owned practice serving Henry County and northwest Ohio.

## Practitioners

- Dr. Timothy Frey, DC — Doctor of Chiropractic, founder. Specializes in gentle, effective spinal adjustments for the whole family.
- Dr. Christopher Peters, DC — Doctor of Chiropractic. Provides chiropractic care and acupuncture services.

## Services

- Chiropractic Adjustments: Gentle, precise spinal adjustments to restore alignment and support natural healing.
- Acupuncture: Traditional acupuncture for pain management, stress reduction, and whole-body wellness.
- Massage Therapy: Therapeutic massage to relieve tension, improve circulation, and complement chiropractic care.
- ChiroThin Weight Loss: A doctor-supervised nutritional support program for healthy, sustainable weight loss.
- Prenatal Chiropractic: Safe, supportive chiropractic care throughout pregnancy.
- Pediatric Chiropractic: Gentle, age-appropriate care for children of all ages.
- Wellness Care: Ongoing maintenance to keep the spine aligned and the body functioning optimally.

## Conditions Treated

- Back Pain
- Neck Pain
- Headaches and Migraines
- Sciatica
- Scoliosis
- Disc Injuries (herniated, bulging, degenerative)
- Whiplash
- Work Injuries
- Arm and Leg Pain
- Carpal Tunnel Syndrome
- Shoulder Pain
- Vertigo
